info.title: CleanExtract
info.description: Convert public HTML or a public URL into token-dense Markdown. Successful extractions cost USD 0.05 through x402 v2 USDC on Base.

post.summary: Extract Markdown from HTML or a public URL

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: Base64-encoded x402 v2 payment payload returned after satisfying the 402 challenge.

url_or_html.description: A public HTTP(S) URL or raw HTML string.

200.description: Extraction succeeded and the response includes PAYMENT-RESPONSE.

400.description: Invalid input or a blocked URL.

402.description: Payment required. Read PAYMENT-REQUIRED for the x402 v2 challenge.

502.description: The public upstream could not be fetched safely.
